evidence: TiO2 films were deposited on an Ir electrode at a deposition temperature of 250°C and a pressure of 3 Torr by PEALD. One deposition cycle of TiO2 consisted of exposure to the TTIP for 3 s, a purge with Ar for 5 s, and an exposure to oxygen reactant for 5 s, followed by a final purge with Ar for 5 s.
